meta.title: AI Application Landscape
meta.method: Application companies are mapped by workflow and geography. Global includes every geography. Asia Pacific includes APAC and Southeast Asia. Companies may appear in more than one vertical.

verticals.name: Assistants and AI search
verticals.workflow: General assistants, research, search, personal agents and knowledge discovery
verticals.economicQuestion: Which products earn repeated user trust and become a new gateway to information?

verticals.name: Productivity and collaboration
verticals.workflow: Documents, meetings, communication, knowledge, scheduling and team coordination
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI reduce administrative work while preserving judgement and organisational memory?

verticals.name: Software and developer tools
verticals.workflow: Code generation, review, debugging, testing, deployment and autonomous software work
verticals.economicQuestion: How much faster can software teams ship while maintaining security and reliability?

verticals.name: Customer service and sales
verticals.workflow: Customer support, contact centres, sales intelligence, CRM and revenue operations
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI improve conversion and service quality without making customer relationships impersonal?

verticals.name: Design and creative production
verticals.workflow: Images, visual design, advertising, presentations and brand production
verticals.economicQuestion: How will creative differentiation change when production becomes cheaper and more abundant?

verticals.name: Video, audio and media
verticals.workflow: Video generation, editing, dubbing, voice, music and interactive content
verticals.economicQuestion: Who captures value when media creation becomes faster, personalised and multilingual?

verticals.name: Healthcare and life sciences
verticals.workflow: Clinical documentation, diagnostics, research, patient operations and remote care
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI improve clinical capacity and care quality without weakening accountability?

verticals.name: Financial services and insurance
verticals.workflow: Risk, fraud, underwriting, research, accounting, customer operations and compliance
verticals.economicQuestion: Can institutions automate routine decisions while preserving explainability and fair access?

verticals.name: Legal and professional services
verticals.workflow: Research, drafting, review, knowledge retrieval and client delivery
verticals.economicQuestion: Will AI expand professional capacity or concentrate the value of expertise in fewer firms?

verticals.name: Cybersecurity, identity and trust
verticals.workflow: Threat detection, identity, application security, fraud defence and AI-system protection
verticals.economicQuestion: Can defenders use AI faster than attackers while keeping automated controls accountable?

verticals.name: Commerce, retail and marketing
verticals.workflow: Discovery, recommendations, merchant tools, advertising, pricing, service and fraud prevention
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI help smaller merchants improve quality and reach without increasing platform dependence?

verticals.name: Manufacturing and industrial operations
verticals.workflow: Factory automation, inspection, digital twins, maintenance, engineering and industrial analytics
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI raise industrial output while creating safe transitions for affected workers?

verticals.name: Robotics and autonomous systems
verticals.workflow: Humanoid robots, warehouse automation, autonomous machines and physical work
verticals.economicQuestion: Which tasks can move from software assistance to safe and economically useful physical autonomy?

verticals.name: Mobility, logistics and supply chain
verticals.workflow: Routing, dispatch, autonomous driving, fleet operations, fulfilment and delivery
verticals.economicQuestion: Where does AI augment operators, and where does autonomy change labour demand?

verticals.name: Agriculture, climate and energy
verticals.workflow: Crop intelligence, weather risk, remote sensing, carbon, energy optimisation and resilience
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI increase output and resilience while reducing waste, emissions and resource use?

verticals.name: Education and workforce learning
verticals.workflow: Tutoring, assessment, content, language learning, teacher support and reskilling
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI make quality learning more accessible without weakening mentorship or foundational skills?

verticals.name: Travel and hospitality
verticals.workflow: Planning, booking, pricing, translation, service and local discovery
verticals.economicQuestion: Can technology make travel easier while preserving human hospitality and local knowledge?

verticals.name: Government, defence and public safety
verticals.workflow: Public services, intelligence, defence autonomy, emergency response and urban operations
verticals.economicQuestion: How should capability, civil rights, national security and human control be balanced?

verticals.name: HR and workforce management
verticals.workflow: Recruiting, payroll, workforce planning, employee support and skills intelligence
verticals.economicQuestion: Can AI improve access to opportunity while avoiding hidden discrimination in employment decisions?
